blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The supposed P120 million “token of gratitude” received by state witness and ex-Public Works Undersecretary Roberto Bernardo from former Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co is just “one percent” of the total amount of alleged kickbacks the former lawmaker received from infrastructure projects nationwide. Bernardo made this revelation as he took the witness stand before the Sandiganbayan Fifth Division on Wednesday where Co and former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) officials face graft case stemming from an allegedly substandard Oriental Mindoro road dike project worth P289.4 million.
